about: P83C T5: the 10 sealed sentences (evals/play/p83/c-sentences.json → sealed), read for the first time. Quick game without a model (draftGameSpecWithMeta(text, 1)), production build, next start :3213, desktop 1280x720 Chromium d3d11. Game started by one click on empty ground at the left edge, shot A after 5 s, then three clicks on things (orrery: on the things from data-orrery-things; other games: stage centre), shot B. Blind judge: codex exec -i sheet.png in an empty mkdtemp dir, contract task.md + output schema, one at a time, web search off, reasoning effort high.

rows.text: show me the solar system and let me tap each planet to learn its name

judge.seen: Panel A shows a central sun surrounded by eight colored planets arranged along orbital rings, with a tap instruction and a 0/9 counter.
judge.reason: The sun and orbiting planets recognizably depict the solar system. Panel B adds planet name labels and yellow highlights, and the counter increases to 3/9.

rows.text: an atom with electrons spinning around the nucleus, clicking an electron makes it glow

judge.seen: Panel A shows a central yellow nucleus surrounded by colored electrons on concentric orbital rings.
judge.reason: The atom has electrons arranged around its nucleus. Panel B adds electron labels and yellow highlight rings, and the counter rises from 0/7 to 3/7.

rows.text: a clockwork machine with gears that turn faster when you tap them

judge.seen: A robot stands in an industrial yard with glowing collectibles, a “Machine” label, and a “Collect the machines!” objective; no recognizable gears.
judge.reason: Panel A shows generic collection gameplay rather than a clockwork machine with gears. Panel B shows no clear click response beyond changes consistent with idle animation.

rows.text: an aquarium with a clownfish, a turtle and a jellyfish, tap one to see what it is

judge.seen: Panel A shows a teal aquarium scene with a fish, turtle, and jellyfish, an instruction naming all three, and a 0/3 counter.
judge.reason: The aquarium contains all three named creatures. Panel B visibly responds with a “You did it!” screen, 565 points, and confirmation that all three were collected.

rows.text: an orchestra on a stage with a violin, a drum, a trumpet and a flute that each get brighter when clicked

judge.seen: Panel A shows a rhythm game with colored note lanes, a character, trees, windmills, and a foreground platform.
judge.reason: The requested orchestra and four instruments are missing. After the clicks, lives drop from two to zero and a “Try again!” screen appears.

rows.text: a map of a little city with a school, a hospital, a park and a station that light up when touched

judge.seen: Four isolated objects on brown ground: a blocklike building, a bedlike object, and pink and green spheres, without landmark labels or streets.
judge.reason: A does not clearly depict a little city with four recognizable landmarks. B adds landmark labels, glowing yellow rings, and increases the counter from 0/4 to 3/4.

rows.text: the human heart with its four chambers, tap a chamber to learn its name

judge.seen: Four separate colored spheres on a brown surface, with a “Tap the chambers!” prompt and a 0/4 counter.
judge.reason: The spheres do not form a recognizable human heart or identify its four chambers. After clicks, three gain glowing rings and “Chamber” labels; the counter reaches 3/4.

rows.text: a volcano island where tapping the volcano, the palm trees or the lava rocks shows their names

judge.seen: Panel A shows a volcano, a palm tree, and a lava rock on reddish terrain, with a 0/3 collection counter.
judge.reason: The named objects are recognizable in panel A. Panel B visibly responds with an all-three-collected victory screen and 565 points.

rows.text: a weather station with a sun, a cloud, a raindrop and a snowflake, click each one to see its name

judge.seen: Panel A shows a sun, cloud, raindrop and snowflake arranged together, with a 0/4 counter and an instruction to tap weather objects.
judge.reason: All four requested weather objects are recognizable. Panel B adds name labels and yellow highlights to three objects, and the counter rises to 3/4.

rows.text: a music box with a ballerina, a star and a moon going around, touch them to make them spin faster

judge.seen: Three objects appear on concentric circular tracks, including a star; text names the ballerina, star, and moon. The counter reads 0/3.
judge.reason: The named objects appear in a circular arrangement. After clicks, a completion screen reports all three collected and awards 565 points, showing a clear response.
